aoci_get_entries.dir: Repository-relative directory whose Entry section to read (not with paths)
aoci_get_entries.object_refs: Canonical Volumes v1 object references, such as database://source/namespace/table
aoci_get_entries.paths: Repository-relative paths of the Entries to read (not with dir)
aoci_get_entries.volume_id: Volumes v1 object Volume: code or database

aoci_maintain.approval_request: Only with intent=human_approval: kind scope_change with the preview_file a paused scope activate saved, or kind onboarding for the prepared review of the current onboarding session
aoci_maintain.intent: cognition_optimization: a bound review of aligned Volumes v1 Code Entries; human_approval: ask the person, in a host dialog, to approve the pending change approval_request names; omit for ordinary Maintain
aoci_maintain.object_refs: code:<path> references that limit cognition_optimization candidates; only with that intent
aoci_maintain.scope: Advanced diagnostic scope; omit it on the ordinary path so shared governance chooses

aoci_overview.check_only: Return only checkpoint facts, without the body
aoci_overview.cognition_receipt: A previous response's cognition_receipt, passed back unchanged
aoci_overview.cursor: The exact next_cursor of the preceding Chunk
aoci_overview.host_delivery_confirmation: Host-observed body bytes, SHA-256, and end marker
aoci_overview.model_cognition_attestation: Submit once after the complete chain: echo the Challenge's index_sha256, entry_sequence_sha256, and entry_count and answer as the final Chunk's attestation_prompt says
aoci_overview.model_cognition_state: Host assessment of its complete cognition: valid, uncertain, or invalid
aoci_overview.probe: check_only only: request a two-question memory probe
aoci_overview.probe_answers: check_only only: memory-only answers to the probe just issued
aoci_overview.refresh_reasons: Host-declared context_compaction and/or phase_transition; semantic_threshold is machine-derived
aoci_overview.scope: all, project, meta, code, or database; Volumes v1 defaults to all
aoci_overview.scope_covered: Whether the task stays within the established cognition scope
aoci_overview.stable_checkpoint: Whether edits and required checks reached a stable checkpoint

aoci_remove_entry.path: Explicit orphan identity returned by governance: code:<path> or a database:// object_ref

aoci_report.note: Why the Entry cannot yet be updated reliably

aoci_search.keyword: Case-insensitive keyword over the whole Entry line (this or tag_filter)
aoci_search.scope: Volumes v1 scope: all, project, meta, code, or database
aoci_search.tag_filter: Tag filter such as A=Index or C>=7 (this or keyword)

aoci_update_entry.code_batch_id: Exact code_plan.batch_id from aoci_maintain, never authoring_batch.batch_identity
aoci_update_entry.entries: The complete candidate set of the current machine-issued batch
aoci_update_entry.entries[].candidate_id: Candidate identity from aoci_maintain, preserved exactly
aoci_update_entry.entries[].new_entry: Complete single-line Entry: filename[tag]: F:... | R:... | A:... | S:...
aoci_update_entry.entries[].object_ref: Canonical Database object identity, instead of path
aoci_update_entry.entries[].path: Repository-relative path of the target file
aoci_update_entry.entries[].source_sha256: Code source binding from aoci_maintain, unchanged
aoci_update_entry.new_entry: Single-Entry compatibility mode with path or object_ref; prefer entries
